digest.component_or_area: rebar logger configuration and pytest integration
propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger process-globally and never restores it, silently breaking caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers in subsequent tests

caplog captures via a handler on the ROOT logger; once propagation is disabled on a rebar.* parent logger, no child records reach caplog, causing assertions to fail with StopIteration or pass vacuously
test failures are intermittent and non-local: the victim test appears unrelated to the actual cause (configure_logging call), making the failure hard to diagnose
the propagate=False mutation is process-global and unscoped to test phases, poisoning all caplog assertions in the current test run that execute after configure_logging() is called
removing propagate=False does not cause double-logging because uvicorn does not add root handlers; the marker-guarded capture handler prevents duplication
